"""Read-only actual raw facial geometry details for b103."""
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
proof=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/root-review-slot-b/rollingb103/verified-binding.json');folder=ROOT/'runtime/root-review-slot-b/rollingb103';items=[]
for index,box,label in [(2,(315,490,590,730),'raw2-nose-mouth'),(3,(235,460,520,710),'raw3-nose-mouth')]:
 e=proof['entries'][index-1];p=ROOT/e['generated_fullsize_image']
 with Image.open(p) as opened: cropped=opened.convert('RGBA').crop(box)
 target=folder/(label+'.png');assert not target.exists();cropped.resize((cropped.width*2,cropped.height*2),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(target)
 items.append({'index':index,'input':e['generated_fullsize_image'],'input_sha256':file_sha256(p),'box':list(box),'nearest_scale':2,'analysis_only':True,'path':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(target)})
write_json(folder/'actual-detail-crops.json',{'machine_id':machine_id(),'created_at_utc':utc_now(),'items':items,'scope':'Actual pixel-only review details; no product mutation or generation.'})
print(json.dumps(items,ensure_ascii=True))

"""Root producer observes a finite source group while the two reviewers review PNGs."""
import json,os,re,sys,uuid
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
from tools.fresh_source_observation_queue import candidates,extract_original
from PIL import Image
folder=ROOT/'runtime/fresh-source-observations'
owner=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production/owner.json')
run=owner['run_id'];assert re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_-]+',run)
assert owner['machine_id']==machine_id()
state=read_json(ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}.json')
assert state['status']=='running' and state['machine_id']==machine_id()
assert not (ROOT/f'runtime/rolling-production/{run}-stop-requested.json').exists()
assert not (ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue/handoff-stop.json').exists()
for p in (folder/'allocations').glob('*.json'):
    old=read_json(p)
    if old['slot']=='producer':assert (ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-fresh-observation-completions/{old["tag"]}.json').exists(),'Unfinished producer original observation; reconcile before allocating more'
plan=read_json(ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json')['batches']
prepared=sum(len(read_json(ROOT/item['jobs'])) for item in plan[state['next_index']:])
intended=sum(len(read_json(p).get('expected_source_keys',[])) for p in (ROOT/'runtime/production-queue/preparation/pending').glob('*.json'))
assert prepared+intended<=8,'Useful prepared supply exists; do not over-reserve originals'
tag='fresh-observed-'+datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')+'-producer-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
selected=[];reserved=folder/'reservations';reserved.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for item in candidates(ROOT):
    path=reserved/(item['key']+'.json')
    try:fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL)
    except FileExistsError:continue
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
        item=extract_original(ROOT,item)
        json.dump({'machine_id':machine_id(),'slot':'producer','tag':tag,'reserved_at_utc':utc_now(),'source':item},stream,ensure_ascii=True)
    selected.append(item)
    if len(selected)==4:break
assert selected,'No unreserved allowed original; do not fabricate one'
allocation=folder/'allocations'/(tag+'.json');assert not allocation.exists()
body={'machine_id':machine_id(),'slot':'producer','tag':tag,'created_at_utc':utc_now(),'sources':selected,
    'producer_supply_context':{'run_id':run,'next_index':state['next_index'],'prepared_requests':prepared,'pending_preparation_requests':intended},
    'scope':'One finite group of original inputs actually observed by the root generation executor during its service/queue wait. Existing a/b portrait reviewers remain the only two output-review slots. No new agent, output approval, image call, retry claim, journal preparation or canonical portrait write. Atomic shared source reservations prevent duplicate claims; normal complete and sole-producer preparation gates remain mandatory.'}
write_json(allocation,body)
views=[]
for item in selected:
    with Image.open(item['original']) as opened:
        image=opened.convert('RGBA');alpha=image.getchannel('A').getextrema()
        target=ROOT/f'runtime/{tag}-{item["key"][:8]}-nearest4.png'
        image.resize((image.width*4,image.height*4),Image.Resampling.NEAREST).save(target)
        views.append({'key':item['key'],'path':item['original'],'sha256':item['original_png_sha256'],'size':list(image.size),'alpha_extrema':list(alpha),'nearest_path':str(target),'nearest_sha256':file_sha256(target)})
result={'tag':tag,'allocation':allocation.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'allocation_sha256':file_sha256(allocation),'config':f'runtime/{tag}-observations.json','sources':selected,'views':views,'created_at_utc':body['created_at_utc'],'mascot_reference_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/assets/reference/naiwa.png')}
write_json(ROOT/'runtime/producer-originals-current-20261025.json',result)
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=True))

"""Save actual v7 delivery, review and local input-recovery boundary."""
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now
def observe(script,*args):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(ROOT/'runtime'/script),*args],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8');assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr;return json.loads(r.stdout)
status=observe('low-production-status-20261025.py','resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7');delivery=observe('low-delivery-status-20261025.py')
verified=sum(x['new_original_PNGs'] for x in delivery['receipts'] if x['status']=='committed_pushed_and_originals_verified')
phase_path=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v7-phase.json';phase=read_json(phase_path);assert phase['current_tag'] is None
target=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v7-followup.json';assert not target.exists()
sources=[]
for name in ['runtime/root-b103-detail-crops-20261025.py','runtime/root-b104-detail-crops-20261025.py','runtime/producer-originals-claim-20261025.py','runtime/producer-originals-complete-20261025.js','runtime/record-low-v7-followup-20261025.py']:
 p=ROOT/name;sources.append({'path':name,'sha256':file_sha256(p),'source':p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
now=utc_now()
write_json(target,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':now,'run_id':'resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v7','actual_builtin_exec_cell':654,'production_status':status,'delivery_status':delivery,'actually_verified_original_PNG_count':verified,'root_b_phase_observed':phase,'root_b_phase_sha256':file_sha256(phase_path),'input_time_recovery':'mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261025-v7-source-clock-reobservation.json','sources':sources,'scope':'Actual intermediate observation only, not task completion or final counts. a/root remain exactly two existing output reviewers; b agent stopped. Builtin sole image producer, frozen requests/cooldowns unchanged, no EvoLink. Runtime helpers preserved for recovery only, never blindly replay mutations. Prepared input supply may temporarily empty; wait is not a service refusal or HIGH completion.'})
handoff=ROOT/'docs/handoffs/2026-10-25-low-resumed.md';text=handoff.read_text(encoding='utf-8');heading='# 钢奶龙心：LOW 已恢复生产\n\n';assert text.startswith(heading)
counts=status['counts']['LOW'];totals=status['same_machine_execution_totals'];phase_state=status['state']
paragraph='UTC'+now+'实读：v7完成'+str(phase_state['completed_source_requests'])+'次调用；本轮累计'+str(totals['PNG_returns'])+'张PNG、'+str(totals['content_refusals'])+'次内容拒绝、'+str(totals['authentication_errors'])+'次认证错误。LOW合格'+str(counts['ready'])+'/703、'+str(counts['pending'])+'待审、'+str(counts['rejected'])+'美术拒绝。原始PNG固定提交远端字节核验累计'+str(verified)+'张，v7首批 `d2bd73ef48ecad7cf491326c6e366aa09c2a89b9` 的16张已实际通过；此后的新返回不提前算作交付。生成仍为cell654，v7原截止UTC07:11:51.649293Z；Git-only进程5372继续，旧阶段预算不重置。root b104实际2通过/2返修（双嘴/可见耳形轮廓），v7 root已完成'+str(phase['completed_groups'])+'组，a111在同一a槽审查。root在旧a组结束后仍用原两个执行者，a的新独立guard/phase为 `runtime/slot-a-v7-owner-guard.py` / `runtime/slot-a-v7-phase-start.json`，实际开始UTC06:25:01.819721，固定截止不延长。\n\n原图组 `fresh-observed-20261025T061255-producer-c5fb0087` 首次complete因秒精度开始06:13:12Z早于实际allocation06:13:12.120816而在写canonical/intent前拒绝；失败草稿保留。root确实重新查看全部native/nearest4，以新实际区间06:21:57Z–06:22:59Z、新immutable配置完成同一4图观察，描述/输入不变，无图片重放。一次cmd type正斜线路径只读错误另保留。后续view起点使用实际毫秒UTC，未改旧时间或伪造先前观察。完整失败草稿、重观察配置和真实完成回执在 `mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261025-v7-source-clock-reobservation.json`；本次补充状态与实际辅助源码在 `mod_nailong/data/production-resumptions/20261025-low-v7-followup.json`。\n\n'
handoff.write_text(heading+paragraph+text[len(heading):],encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'audit':target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'production_status':status,'verified_originals':verified,'phase_groups':phase['completed_groups']},ensure_ascii=True))

scope: Actual intermediate observation only, not task completion or final counts. a/root remain exactly two existing output reviewers; b agent stopped. Builtin sole image producer, frozen requests/cooldowns unchanged, no EvoLink. Runtime helpers preserved for recovery only, never blindly replay mutations.
